segments.t: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit,
but test the spirits, whether they are of God,
segments.note: 主語の「they」は πνεύματα を受ける補い

segments.t: because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
By this you know the Spirit of God:
every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh
segments.note: 「that」は ὁμολογεῖ の内容を表す補い

segments.t: is of God,
and every spirit who doesn’t confess
that Jesus
segments.note: 「that」は ὁμολογεῖ の内容を表す補い

segments.t: Christ has come in the flesh
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Christ has come in the flesh」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: is not of God;
and this is the spirit of the Antichrist,
segments.note: 「spirit」は τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου（反キリストのもの）を受ける補い

segments.t: of whom you have heard that it comes.
segments.note: 主語の「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: Now it is in the world already.
segments.note: καὶ（24番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。主語の「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: You are of God, little children,
and have overcome them,
because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
segments.note: ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν（あなたがたのうちにおられる方）を「he who is in you」と訳す

segments.t: They are of the world.
Therefore they speak of the world,
segments.note: 主語の「they」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: and the world hears them.
We are of God.
He who knows God listens to us.
segments.note: 「listens to」は ἀκούει＋属格の表現

segments.t: He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us.
By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
segments.note: 「By」は ἐκ τούτου の表現

segments.t: Beloved, let’s love one another,
for love is of God;
and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God,
for God is love.
By this God’s love was revealed in us,
that God has sent his only born Son into the world
that we might live through him.
In this is love,
not that we loved God,
but that he loved us,
and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
segments.note: 「as」は ἱλασμὸν の同格を表す補い。定冠詞「the」は英語の補い

segments.t: Beloved, if God loved us in this way,
we also ought to love one another.
No one has seen God at any time.
If we love one another,
God remains in us,
and his love has been perfected in us.
By this we know that we remain in him and he in us,
because he has given us of his Spirit.
segments.note: 主語の「he」は英語の補い（δέδωκεν の主語）

segments.t: We have seen
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: and testify
that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
segments.note: 「as」は σωτῆρα の同格を表す補い

segments.t: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God,
God remains in him, and he in God.
segments.note: 後半の「remains」は μένει の繰り返しとして補われる

segments.t: We know and have believed the love which God has for us.
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。「for us」は ἐν ἡμῖν の意訳

segments.t: God is love,
and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
In this, love has been made perfect among us,
that we may have boldness in the day of judgment,
because as he is, even so we are in this world.
segments.note: 「even so」は英語の補い

segments.t: There is no fear in love;
segments.note: 「There is」は存在表現の補い

segments.t: but perfect love casts out fear,
segments.note: 「casts out」は ἔξω βάλλει の句動詞化

segments.t: because fear has punishment.
He who fears is not made perfect in love.
We love
him,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「him」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: because he first loved us.
If a man says, “I love God,”
and hates his brother,
he is a liar;
segments.note: 主語の「he」と不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen,
how can he love God whom he has not seen?
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文の語順（τὸν θεὸν ὃν οὐχ ἑώρακεν οὐ δύναται ἀγαπᾶν）を WEB が疑問文に組み替えた箇所。「how」は英語の補い、否定は修辞疑問に吸収される

segments.t: This commandment we have from him,
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: that he who loves God should also love his brother.
segments.note: 「should」は ἵνα 節の表出
